code='''def transform(grid):
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 1):
            if all(grid[i][j] == 0 for i in (r, r + 1) for j in (c, c + 1)):

                for j in range(w):
                    if grid[r][j] != 2: out[r][j] = 0
                    if grid[r + 1][j] != 2: out[r + 1][j] = 0

    return out
